name: Browse Eko in Kanada branding and full menu
description: Verifies the updated brand name and menu from the catering flyer are presented on the home page.
steps: Check rice, soups, proteins and specials
expected: The page uses Eko in Kanada branding and lists the menu items supplied in the flyer.

name: Find catering services and event types
description: Verifies catering services are promoted for the four event types listed in the flyer.
expected: Weddings, birthday parties, corporate events and anniversaries are listed, with a working WhatsApp enquiry link.

name: Use WhatsApp ordering on mobile
description: Verifies visitors on a mobile screen can find the menu and contact the business.
steps: Open the home page at mobile width
Scroll to the menu or catering section
expected: The menu remains readable on mobile and the contact link opens WhatsApp.
